name: dispatching-parallel-agents
title_zh: 两件以上互不搭界的活，同时开跑不排队
tagline_zh: 手里攒着好几件互不相干的活儿，一件件排队太慢。它帮你同时调度，各自跑各自的，不抢内存不打架，省下的时间够你喝杯咖啡。
tagline_en: Got multiple unrelated tasks? Stop doing them one by one. This dispatches them in parallel, no shared-state.
desc_en: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
why_zh: 它不靠猜，而是明确识别任务间无共享状态、无先后依赖，才放心并行。机制上杜绝了死锁和资源抢占。
why_en: It only parallelizes when tasks share no state and no dependencies, preventing deadlocks and resource contention—more reliable.
limit_zh: 只认独立任务，若任务间有共享数据或顺序要求，它不会并行，会退回串行。且需你预先拆好任务边界，不能自动分解复杂项目。
limit_en: Only for independent tasks; if shared state or order matters, it falls back to serial. You must pre-split tasks; it won't decompose complex projects.
title_en: Run 2+ independent tasks in parallel, no queueing
